status: DRAFT (not registered; SPEC_SHA256 None; dates, k_tests, census scales and cuts null until E022 and the censuses)
design: docs/research_lab/LIVE_TESTS_6.md (sections 0-13 as amended by 14 and 15; 15 governs, then 14)

experiments.K: CH185 clip trains by size identity

dates_comment: NULL PLACEHOLDERS ON PURPOSE (design 1.1, R1 item 7). REGISTERED_UTC = the first 00:00Z that is (a) >= 24 h after the LT6 registration commit, (b) >= 48 h after LT5's REGISTERED_UTC, (c) >= E022's own END_UTC if E022 is registered, (d) never before 2026-11-16T00:00Z; END_UTC = REGISTERED_UTC + 21 d; analysis = END_UTC + 36 h. Proposed values (NOT the spec's): 2026-11-16T00:00:00Z / 2026-12-07T00:00:00Z / 2026-12-08T12:00:00Z. The whole family (and every embargo date) slides with E022; live_tests6.registered_utc_rule computes them from no data.

e022.t_e022_rule: T_E022 = the earlier of E022's analysis job start (the queue log's start time) and E022's analysis commit; V is registered only if the LT6 registration commit is strictly before T_E022, else V is dropped uncounted (R1 re-check item 1)
e022.comment: all null until E022 registers or drops; filled from the ledger, never from data

k_tests_rule: the tests whose census gate passes (section 7); fixed at registration, never changed; a size-scenario failure sets only its own tests to p = 1 (1.8)
code_sha_rule: normalised sha256 (SPEC_SHA256 line excluded) of live_tests6.py, live_tests6_analysis.py and every hashed dependency named in live_tests6.CODE_FILES

eligibility.rule: section 1.4: binary, not closed, active, two-sided (0 < bid < ask <= 1) and spread <= 0.10 (Gamma spread, else ask - bid) at k-1 and k; one row per market_id and per condition_id (first in page order). V and K use items 1-8; D and B use items 1-3, 6, 7, mid_k in [0.05, 0.95] and as-of end > t_k + 27 h

sports_rule: cb17_census.is_sports_sidecar(fee_type, fee_category, series_slugs) on the sidecar of the capture; sidecar missing -> sports = -1 (unknown; excluded wherever the category is needed)

crypto_rule.rule: series-key rule inherited from LT5 (live_tests5_base.category_cols); NOT the pinned classifier below

crypto_classifier.failsafe: if no distinct fee_category value of the whole sealed sidecar set contains 'crypto', B's crypto gate and D's crypto kill line are NaN and fail
crypto_classifier.rule: section 5 as pinned by the R1 re-check (section 15 item R2)

move.class_rule: never_traded > traded > ambiguous > quote_only; geometry parallel / one_sided / spread_change / same_side_unequal (LT5 spec move block, unchanged)

v.first_origin_rule: first pass whose k-1 capture AND k-1 sweep both start at or after E022's END_UTC; earlier passes counted e022_boundary
v.rule: section 2: v = sign(x) imb_k, v_prev = sign(x) imb_{k-1}, imb = (D_bid_5c - D_ask_5c)/(D_bid_5c + D_ask_5c) on the outcome-0 book of sweep 1; target c_vskip = sign(x)(smid_{k+3} - smid_{k+1})

k.rule: section 3 as amended by R1 item 12 and R1 re-check n5: deterministic greedy per (asset, Decimal(size text).normalize()); rows <= 2 x order_min_size (Decimal) removed first; sizes read as text

d.rule: section 4; parse rules pinned (fromisoformat with a trailing Z replaced by +00:00; naive = UTC; date-only or unparseable = no template and no class; equality to the second)

b.rule: section 5 as amended by R1 items 3-4 and the re-check: clean no-birth class; crypto is a census gate only

arms.rule: reported arms frozen by the reader beside each primary population (section 16): sports (V S3, D S5, B S5), decided (D P2: mid_k < 0.03 or > 0.97), tail (B S1: neg-risk incumbents with mid_k in [0.02, 0.10)); primaries and censuses read arm == main

gates.perm_method: Freedman-Lane (K, D, B); block circular-shift Freedman-Lane (V) (LIVE_TESTS_6.md 1.8)

inference.p_rule: p = max(p_event on t with G_event - 1 df, p_two_way normal, p_day on t with G_day - 1 df); D and B: event t on G_treated - 1 df (smaller of that and G_series - 1 where the series family is not excluded)
inference.estimator: expanding-past demeaning of every regressor, target raw, first unit of each market dropped

size_check.result_rule: the committed binding size-check result (run_live_tests6.py size-check, no --dev) and its sha256, filled at registration; the analysis refuses to run unless the file hashes to result_sha256 and was produced on the pinned code

rate_limits.binding_gate: nominal + 1.645 sqrt(nominal (1 - nominal) / worlds) = 0.058 at 2,000 worlds

size_check.rule: rate <= limit per binding scenario; one run on the code to be pinned, after the censuses; binding scenarios 1-11 draw from the one generator seeded 20261167 in table order; non-binding runs use their own generators; a failing scenario sets only the tests it is binding for to 'SE check failed (size scenario)', p = 1, k unchanged; no rerun, reseed or variant

census_inputs.capture_seal: docs/research_lab/seals/lt6_census_inputs.json (written by run_live_tests6.py seal from the restore report; committed before any LT6 census)
census_inputs.projection: counts x 21 / census days (estimate); distinct events: E_2d + (E_2d - E_day1) x 19 for two-day censuses, covered-days scaling for CD and CB; effective = units in markets with >= 2 units; D and B counts, n2_eff and VIF_w are computed after the washout and (B) the clean no-birth rule

mde_common.rule: DE_gate = max(3.0, 1 + (m_21 - 1) 0.02, 1 + (m_co - 1) 0.5), m_co = sum m^2 / sum m over event x capture cells with >= 1 labelled unit (D, B; 1 for V, K); class MDE = t_sum SD sqrt(1/n1 + 1/n2) sqrt(DE_gate) day sqrt(max(1, VIF_w)); V slope = max(declared, design); NaN VIF_w fails

labels.partially_seen_comment: D carries 'partially seen' unless the CB18 change request (design 14.6) is recorded as applied before the pin, or if any 1.6 breach is recorded; null until recorded

vendored_source_drift_rule: LT6 imports the LT3/LT4/LT5 helpers instead of vendoring them (no live_tests6_base yet); the design's 8.1 vendoring after LT5's pin is deferred to the pin step
